## Summary
PrintWeek announcement of the formal Connect: Switch integration between Infigo and Enfocus. Page returned thin JS shell on fetch; content reconstructed from search summaries. Significance: this is the *Infigo-side* version of the integration story, complementing the Enfocus-side "Infigo Connect" app launch.

## Key takeaways
- Two parallel apps exist for the same data path:
  1. **Connect: Switch** (Infigo side) — Infigo's plugin that talks to Switch.
  2. **Infigo Connect app** (Enfocus side) — Switch app that pulls Infigo data in.
- Either side can drive depending on whose UI the customer prefers to configure in.
- Confirms Enfocus partnership predates the AppStore release of Infigo Connect.
- **Caveat:** Page returned a JS shell; details limited.
